title: 机场观察小游戏
prompt: 做个给六岁孩子玩的机场寻宝小游戏，不跑远、不打扰别人，找到一项就能打勾。
program:
root = Col([pageTitle, intro, game, Celebration(allDone)])
$got = []
found = @Count($got)
total = @Count(items)
percent = @Round(@Percent(found, total))
allDone = found == total
done = Text("已完成 " + found + " / " + total, "sm", "ink", "medium")
barFill = Box([], "row", 0, 0, "success", "full", false, percent + "%", 10)
barTrack = Box([barFill], "row", 0, 0, "surface", "full", false, "100%", 10)
progress = Col([Row([Badge("示例任务", "purple"), Spacer(), done], 2), barTrack, Text("找到一个就打勾，集齐会有小庆祝。", "xs", "muted")], 3)
itemRows = Col(@Each(items, "it", Pressable([Row([Text(it.emoji, "lg"), Col([Text(it.label, "md", null, "medium", false, @Includes($got, it.id)), Text(it.hint, "xs", "muted")], 1), Spacer(), Icon(@Includes($got, it.id) ? "check-circle" : "circle", "lg", @Includes($got, it.id) ? "success" : "muted")], 3, "center")], @Set($got, @Toggle($got, it.id)), @Includes($got, it.id), 3)), 2)
resetBtn = Button("重新开始", @Reset($got), "outline", null, "md", "rotate-ccw", found == 0)
statusText = Text(allDone ? "太棒啦！全部找到！" : "慢慢来，不用一次找完。", "sm", "muted")
game = Card([Title("机场寻宝", "md"), Text("脚步轻轻，牵好大人的手。", "sm", "muted"), progress, Divider(), itemRows, Row([resetBtn, Spacer(), statusText], 3, "center")], "soft", 4, 4)
pageTitle = Title("✈️ 机场寻宝", "xl")
intro = Text("这是给六岁小朋友的**机场寻宝游戏**：在登机口附近慢慢找，不跑远、不吵闹。找到一项就轻轻打个勾吧。", "md")
items = [{id: "plane", emoji: "🛫", label: "找到一架停在登机口的飞机", hint: "在窗边看，不用跑。"}, {id: "bags", emoji: "🧳", label: "找到三种不同颜色的行李箱", hint: "轻轻看，不碰别人的箱子。"}, {id: "staff", emoji: "🧑‍✈️", label: "看到一位穿制服的工作人员", hint: "可以微笑打招呼。"}, {id: "clock", emoji: "🕒", label: "找到一块显示时间的屏幕", hint: "抬头找找登机信息屏。"}, {id: "sign", emoji: "🟢", label: "找到一个绿色的安全出口标志", hint: "记住它在哪里。"}, {id: "shop", emoji: "💧", label: "找到一家卖水的商店", hint: "不用买，只要看到。"}]
